title: DUNE
subtitle: A child answers seven questions; H searches the web for real lessons and builds a personal tutor that teaches, speaks and remembers.
forWhom: for pupils of 8 to 18 who want to go further than class, and their parents
intro: Three episodes: Andy builds his own tutor, his parent checks what H found, and Andy takes a first lesson in the Tutor Room.

setup.name: What was set up
setup.text: A local workspace with one demo account. Andy, 11, is an invented learner who dreams of Mars. No real child's data.

agent.name: What the agent does
agent.text: H browses the open web for lessons that fit the age and level, and writes the tutor's skill.md brain. Gradium reads the tutor aloud. The child and the parent decide what to learn.

notFinished: The teacher's class view: one request, a path per level.
Automatic safety screening of each resource, shown with its reason.

episodes.title: Andy builds his tutor
episodes.situation: Andy dreams of going to Mars and wants the maths behind it. He opens Tutor Studio; no tutor exists yet.

steps.see: The first of seven questions: « Hi! What should your tutor call you? »
expect: What should your tutor call you

steps.do: Type « Andy », « 11 » and « Maths for a mission to Mars », each followed by « Next ».
steps.see: « What is your current level? » with three choices.

steps.do: Pick « I know the basics », « Stories and analogies », « Warm and encouraging » and « English ».
steps.see: « Ready? » with Andy's profile in six chips.
« Creating your tutor… »: H is researching lessons on the web, about a minute.
Andy's tutor, its name and welcome, with « Listen » (Gradium's voice) and « Start learning ».

episodes.title: The parent checks what H found
episodes.situation: The tutor exists. Before Andy starts, his parent wants to see what it will teach and where it comes from.

steps.see: The tutor's « Lessons », each with a « Try it: » exercise, and its « Sources », the web pages H used.
The tutor as a skill.md file: « Give this tutor to any AI agent. »

episodes.title: A first lesson in the Tutor Room
episodes.situation: Andy opens his tutor. The first module is ready and the tutor greets him.

steps.see: The Tutor Room: the first module, the tutor's welcome and « Write your answer ».

steps.do: Write « I'm ready! What is my first mission? » and click « Send ».
steps.see: The tutor answers in its own words and the progress bar moves.
« Tutor's brain · skill.md »: the roadmap, the research notes and Andy's learner state, updated after his answer.

closing.title: What comes next
closing.text: A class view for teachers, the safety screening shown with its reasons, and the same tutor opened from any agent through MCP.
